limitations: Olist payment approval date is used as paid_at; not order purchase or delivery date.
Approved canceled orders remain included; refunds are not deducted from Gross GMV.
Payment rows are not joined to item rows; payment_value is not merchandise amount.
Customer lifetime first payment is unavailable: customer_type and new/returning metrics are disabled.
Channel, campaign, confirmed refunds, and actual delivery region are unavailable.
This is a historical public dataset snapshot; production completeness is not asserted.
